name: Video Forum / QA / Discussion Board
author: videowhisper

sections.description:
Create a discussion board for a class, member community, product support team, or other group that benefits from demonstrating a question or answer. Visitors can browse forums, search topic titles within a forum, and read replies. Signed-in members with permission can start topics and reply from the frontend.

  • Create forums and nested subforums from a forum directory.
  • Choose who can create and manage forums, topics, and replies.
  • Mark an accepted answer, show solved topics, and let members report content to authorized moderators.
  • Let members opt in to email when someone replies to an individual topic.
  • Set hourly posting and report limits. Optional Site Manager tools support draft topics and replies, separately approved publishing, and moderation.
  • Find topics by title, filter by solved or unsolved, and sort by latest edit or newest topic.
  • Attach files to replies and add featured images to discussions.
  • Use the optional Video Comments Recorder to add webcam video, microphone audio, screen recordings, photos, or screenshots to replies. Captured video, audio, and images display inline.
  • Use the optional MicroPayments plugin to configure access to eligible content.
sections.installation:
1. Activate Video Forum.
  2. Open Video Forum → Pages, then create the forum directory or select a page containing the [videowhisper_forum] shortcode.
  3. View the directory while signed in, select Create forum, and save it. Open the new forum, select Start a topic, and publish your first topic.
  4. Review Video Forum → Permissions to choose who can create or manage discussions.
  5. For browser capture, activate Video Comments Recorder 2.4.2 or later and enable the desired capture modes in its settings. Check Video Forum → Media and make sure capture is enabled.
sections.faq:
How do I follow a topic by email?

An administrator can enable topic email in Video Forum → Participation. Signed-in members can then select Email me new replies on a topic. Each email has a link to stop emails for that topic without signing in. Members can also stop emails from the topic page. The plugin uses the site’s WordPress email delivery and scheduled tasks. It checks that you can still read both the topic and reply. Password-protected discussions do not send email.

How can a member or moderator use a connected agent?

In Video Forum → Participation, enable the integration with VideoWhisper Site Manager 1.30.8 or later and decide whether agents may assist moderators. In Site Manager, enable the relevant forum post types and approve the exact tools for the required roles and connections. Agents can save plain-text drafts. Publishing a reviewed draft also requires Site Manager content publishing, a connection with publishing access, and native publishing and forum permissions. Moderation tools let authorized editors and administrators review and resolve reports or close and reopen replies.

How do I add a capture to a reply?

On a topic page, open a recorder from the reply form and allow the browser permission it needs. Save the capture in the recorder, then select Post reply. Available modes depend on recorder settings and browser support. Browser capture normally requires HTTPS on a hosted site.

Can I remove a featured image without deleting the file?

Yes. The edit form removes the current featured-image association. The file remains in the WordPress Media Library and can still be used elsewhere.

Are attachments protected by discussion access rules?

A protected discussion hides its media links from visitors who cannot read it. Standard WordPress upload URLs can be accessed directly by anyone who knows the URL. Use a protected delivery service for private media.

Does the plugin connect to an external service?

Forum pages, topic search, and ordinary attachments use WordPress. Native browser capture is provided by the optional Video Comments Recorder. If you configure that plugin to use an external legacy recorder, its service terms and privacy policy also apply.

The Connect tab links to the support portal and supports the optional VideoWhisper CRM Connection companion when the provider lists Video Forum. Connecting requires the administrator’s explicit consent. The companion sends your site’s URL, the plugin identity, and the contact details you submit to VideoWhisper CRM to prefill and manage support requests. Privacy policy and terms of use.

Where can I get help?

Use the WordPress.org support forum for plugin questions.

Where is the source for the bundled interface stylesheet?

The stylesheet is based on the MIT-licensed Fomantic UI 2.8.8 source. See the bundled scripts/semantic/SOURCE.txt for the upstream distribution and the local change.
sections.changelog:
1.5.0

  • Add optional topic reply emails with explicit opt-in and unsubscribe controls.
  • Check recipient access at delivery and prevent duplicate notifications for the same reply.

1.4.0

  • Add accepted answers, solved labels, and solved or unsolved topic filters.
  • Add member reports, a moderator queue, and controls to close or reopen replies.
  • Add configurable hourly member limits and opt-in Site Manager tools for drafts, publication, and moderation.

1.3.0

  • Fix frontend edit and deletion authorization, including target and parent validation and scoped form tokens.
  • Remove a featured image without deleting its file or unrelated attachments.
  • Add inline video, audio, and image capture through current Video Comments Recorder releases.
  • Add topic title search, sorting, refreshed settings and an optional support connection.
  • Require WordPress 6.9 and PHP 8.3.

1.2.9

  • Escape stored topic titles in the frontend edit form.

1.2.8

  • Move screenshots to the directory assets and recognize signed recorder attachments.

1.2.7

  • Previous maintenance release.

1.2

  • Add file attachments, featured image uploads, and recorder and MicroPayments integrations.

1.1

  • Add custom permissions.

1.0

  • First version.
